answer.example_en: I woke up before my alarm rang.
answer.example_zh: 闹钟还没响，我就醒了。
answer.usage_note: wake up指从睡眠中醒来；醒来后不一定马上离开床。
answer.contrast_note: wake up侧重醒来，get up侧重起床离床。

answer.example_en: I get up at seven on weekdays.
answer.example_zh: 工作日我七点起床。
answer.usage_note: get up在此指起床，强调离开床开始一天的活动。
answer.contrast_note: 与wake up（醒来）相比，get up强调实际起身。

answer.example_en: It was so cold that I didn't want to get out of bed.
answer.example_zh: 天太冷了，我不想从床上起来。
collocations: struggle to get out of bed
answer.usage_note: get out of bed明确表示离开床铺；常与时间或意愿搭配。

answer.example_en: I like to sleep in on Saturday mornings.
answer.example_zh: 星期六早上我喜欢睡懒觉。
answer.usage_note: sleep in表示比平时睡得晚，通常是主动享受晚起。
answer.contrast_note: oversleep通常表示无意中睡过头，sleep in往往是有意晚起。

answer.example_en: I overslept and missed the bus.
answer.example_zh: 我睡过头了，没赶上公交车。
answer.usage_note: oversleep表示睡过了原本打算起床的时间，常带来迟到等后果。
answer.contrast_note: 不同于主动睡懒觉的sleep in。

rows.gloss: 按闹钟贪睡键，让闹钟稍后再响；小睡一会儿

answer.meaning_zh: 按闹钟贪睡键，让闹钟稍后再响；小睡一会儿
answer.example_en: I pressed snooze and went back to sleep for ten minutes.
answer.example_zh: 我按了闹钟的贪睡键，又睡了十分钟。
answer.usage_note: 在闹钟语境中，snooze表示暂时延后提醒；也可指小睡。
answer.contrast_note: snooze the alarm是延后提醒，turn off the alarm是关掉提醒。

answer.example_en: I wake up early when I have a morning flight.
answer.example_zh: 要赶早班飞机时，我会早早醒来。
answer.usage_note: early修饰醒来的时间；是否马上起床由上下文决定。

answer.example_en: I woke up late, but I still made it to work on time.
answer.example_zh: 我醒得晚，但还是准时上班了。
answer.usage_note: wake up late只表示醒来时间晚，并不一定等于迟到。
answer.contrast_note: oversleep通常暗含超过预定起床时间；wake up late并不必然如此。

answer.example_en: I get up early to catch the first train.
answer.example_zh: 为了赶上首班火车，我早早起床。
answer.usage_note: get up early强调很早就起身离床，而不仅是清醒。

answer.example_en: I got up late and skipped my usual morning walk.
answer.example_zh: 我起床晚了，就没进行平时的晨间散步。
answer.usage_note: get up late侧重离床时间较晚，是否睡过头取决于语境。

answer.example_en: My alarm rang at six this morning.
answer.example_zh: 今天早上六点，我的闹铃响了。
answer.usage_note: alarm在此指闹铃或提醒声；也可以表示警报。
answer.contrast_note: alarm是提醒或警报，alarm clock特指闹钟设备。

answer.example_en: I keep an alarm clock beside my bed.
answer.example_zh: 我把一个闹钟放在床边。
answer.usage_note: alarm clock是用于定时提醒的设备；clock本身不一定具有闹铃功能。

answer.example_en: Don't forget to set an alarm for six tomorrow.
answer.example_zh: 别忘了把明天的闹钟设在六点。
answer.usage_note: set an alarm for + 时间，表示预设闹钟响起的时间。
answer.contrast_note: set an alarm是设置闹钟，alarm goes off是闹钟响起。

answer.example_en: My alarm goes off at half past six every morning.
answer.example_zh: 每天早上六点半，我的闹钟都会响。
answer.usage_note: go off与alarm搭配时指突然响起，并非关掉。
answer.contrast_note: turn off an alarm才是关闭闹钟。

answer.example_en: I pressed the snooze button twice before getting up.
answer.example_zh: 起床前我按了两次贪睡键。
answer.usage_note: snooze button指让闹钟稍后再次响起的按钮或功能。

answer.example_en: I'm running late, so I'll have breakfast on the way.
answer.example_zh: 我快迟到了，所以打算在路上吃早饭。
answer.usage_note: running late意为时间不够、进度落后，通常表示可能迟到。
answer.contrast_note: 不是字面上的跑步动作。

answer.example_en: My morning routine starts with a glass of water.
answer.example_zh: 我的晨间例行活动从喝一杯水开始。
answer.usage_note: morning routine指早上经常重复的一组习惯或活动。

answer.example_en: I yawned because I was still sleepy.
answer.example_zh: 我还很困，所以打了个哈欠。
answer.usage_note: yawn是打哈欠；可作动词，也可作名词。

answer.example_en: I stretch for a minute after getting out of bed.
answer.example_zh: 下床后，我会伸展身体一分钟。
answer.usage_note: stretch在此指伸展身体或肌肉，也可以说stretch your legs。

answer.example_en: I make the bed after I get dressed.
answer.example_zh: 穿好衣服后，我会整理床铺。
answer.usage_note: make the bed表示整理被褥和床单，不是制造床。

answer.example_en: I woke up tired even though I had slept for eight hours.
answer.example_zh: 虽然睡了八小时，我醒来还是很累。
collocations: wake up tired after a long night
answer.usage_note: 醒来之后仍然疲倦，并非没有醒来。

answer.example_en: Wash your face with warm water before breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 早餐前用温水洗洗脸。
collocations: wash your face in the morning
answer.usage_note: wash your face是洗脸；face是宾语，常说wash my face等。

answer.example_en: I brush my teeth after breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 我早餐后刷牙。
collocations: brush your teeth twice a day
answer.usage_note: teeth是tooth的复数；通常说brush my/your teeth。

answer.example_en: I need ten minutes to get ready before we leave.
answer.example_zh: 出门前我需要十分钟准备。
answer.usage_note: get ready可指为出门或活动做好准备，常与for/to搭配。

answer.example_en: We usually have breakfast together at eight.
answer.example_zh: 我们通常八点一起吃早饭。
answer.usage_note: have breakfast表示吃早餐，不必理解为拥有早餐。

answer.example_en: I was awake long before the alarm went off.
answer.example_zh: 闹钟响之前很久我就已经醒着了。
answer.usage_note: awake强调清醒状态；wake up强调从睡眠中醒来的动作。

answer.example_en: My brother is already up and making coffee.
answer.example_zh: 我弟弟已经起床，正在煮咖啡了。
answer.usage_note: be up可表示已经起床，也可能泛指醒着；此处由making coffee确定已起床。

answer.example_en: I couldn't fall asleep because the room was noisy.
answer.example_zh: 房间太吵，我一直睡不着。
answer.usage_note: fall asleep表示进入睡眠状态，不能与wake up混淆。

answer.example_en: After drinking some water, I went back to sleep.
answer.example_zh: 喝过水之后，我又睡着了。
collocations: try to go back to sleep
answer.usage_note: go back to sleep表示已经醒过来后再次入睡。

answer.example_en: I drifted off while listening to quiet music.
answer.example_zh: 听着轻柔的音乐，我渐渐睡着了。
answer.usage_note: drift off通常强调不知不觉、渐渐进入睡眠。

answer.example_en: I dozed off on the sofa for a few minutes.
answer.example_zh: 我在沙发上不知不觉打了几分钟的盹。
answer.usage_note: doze off通常指不经意间睡着，可能只是短暂打盹。

answer.example_en: I like to lie in on Sundays when I have no plans.
answer.example_zh: 星期天没安排时，我喜欢睡懒觉。
answer.usage_note: lie in是英式英语中常见的晚起表达，与美式sleep in相近。

answer.example_en: It's raining, so I'd rather stay in bed a little longer.
answer.example_zh: 下雨了，我宁愿在床上多待一会儿。
answer.usage_note: stay in bed表示继续待在床上，不一定一直在睡。

answer.example_en: I lay awake for an hour thinking about tomorrow.
answer.example_zh: 我躺在床上清醒了一个小时，一直想着明天的事。
answer.usage_note: lie awake表示躺着没睡着；过去式为lay awake。

answer.example_en: I tossed and turned all night because I was worried.
answer.example_zh: 我因为担心，整晚都辗转反侧。
answer.usage_note: toss and turn常描述睡觉时翻来覆去、难以安睡。

answer.example_en: Our baby finally slept through the night.
answer.example_zh: 我们的宝宝终于一觉睡到了天亮。
answer.usage_note: sleep through the night通常表示夜间没有明显醒来打断睡眠。

answer.example_en: I'm a light sleeper, so even small noises wake me up.
answer.example_zh: 我睡眠很浅，一点小声响就会把我吵醒。
answer.usage_note: light sleeper指容易被动静吵醒的人，不是睡眠时间短的人。

answer.example_en: He's a heavy sleeper and rarely hears his alarm.
answer.example_zh: 他睡得很沉，几乎听不到闹钟。
answer.usage_note: heavy sleeper指睡得沉、不容易被吵醒的人。

answer.example_en: I try to get enough sleep before a busy day.
answer.example_zh: 忙碌的一天开始前，我尽量睡够觉。
answer.usage_note: enough修饰sleep表示睡眠量足够。

answer.example_en: I'm short on sleep after working late all week.
answer.example_zh: 这周一直加班到很晚，我现在睡眠不足。
answer.usage_note: be short on sleep表示睡眠不足；short on表示某物不够。

answer.example_en: I plan to catch up on sleep this weekend.
answer.example_zh: 这个周末我打算补补觉。
collocations: catch up on sleep over the weekend
need to catch up on sleep
answer.usage_note: 指通过多休息弥补此前缺少的睡眠，不表示一定能消除所有缺觉影响。

answer.example_en: I need to get a good night's sleep before the exam.
answer.example_zh: 考试前我需要睡个好觉。
answer.usage_note: night's是所有格，整个短语指一晚质量良好的睡眠。

answer.example_en: After a restless night, I felt exhausted at work.
answer.example_zh: 一夜睡得不安稳，我上班时筋疲力尽。
answer.usage_note: restless night是睡不踏实、频繁醒来或难以安睡的一夜。

answer.example_en: I had a rough night because the baby kept waking up.
answer.example_zh: 宝宝不停醒来，我昨晚睡得很不好。
answer.usage_note: rough night可泛指难熬的一夜；在此场景专指睡眠受干扰。

answer.example_en: I feel well-rested after sleeping for nine hours.
answer.example_zh: 睡了九个小时，我感觉休息得很充分。
answer.usage_note: well-rested表示已得到充分休息，常作表语。

answer.example_en: I felt sleep-deprived after several late nights.
answer.example_zh: 连续几晚熬夜后，我感到严重缺觉。
answer.usage_note: sleep-deprived表示长期或一段时间睡眠不足，比普通sleepy含义更具体。

answer.example_en: I'm sleepy, so I'll go to bed early tonight.
answer.example_zh: 我很困，今晚要早点睡。
answer.usage_note: sleepy表示有睡意；asleep表示已经睡着。

answer.example_en: I was still half-asleep when the phone rang.
answer.example_zh: 电话响的时候，我还半睡半醒。
answer.usage_note: half-asleep描述未完全清醒的状态。

answer.example_en: I was wide awake by the time the sun came up.
answer.example_zh: 太阳升起时，我已经完全清醒了。
answer.usage_note: wide awake表示非常清醒，与sleepy相反。

answer.example_en: I'm a morning person and do my best work before noon.
answer.example_zh: 我是个习惯早起的人，中午前工作效率最高。
answer.usage_note: morning person指早晨精神和效率较好的人，不只是某天起得早。

answer.example_en: My brother is a night owl and rarely goes to bed before midnight.
answer.example_zh: 我弟弟是个夜猫子，几乎从不在午夜前睡觉。
answer.usage_note: 常指习惯晚睡、晚上更精神的人。

answer.example_en: I'm trying to keep a regular sleep schedule.
answer.example_zh: 我正在努力保持规律的作息时间。
answer.usage_note: sleep schedule指入睡和起床的时间安排。

answer.example_en: Traveling across time zones can disrupt your body clock.
answer.example_zh: 跨越时区旅行会打乱你的生物钟。
answer.usage_note: body clock指身体调节睡眠和清醒等节律的机制。

answer.example_en: I often wake up near the end of a sleep cycle.
answer.example_zh: 我常在一个睡眠周期快结束时醒来。
answer.usage_note: sleep cycle是睡眠不同阶段构成的周期。

answer.example_en: I turned off the alarm as soon as it started ringing.
answer.example_zh: 闹钟一响，我就把它关掉了。
answer.usage_note: turn off是关闭；不是snooze的延后再次提醒。

answer.example_en: I hit snooze twice before I finally got up.
answer.example_zh: 我按了两次贪睡键，才终于起床。
answer.usage_note: 口语中hit snooze表示按下延后响铃的功能。

answer.example_en: I slept through the alarm and woke up an hour late.
answer.example_zh: 闹钟响了我也没醒，晚了一个小时才起床。
answer.usage_note: sleep through表示声音等发生时仍然睡着。

answer.example_en: I missed the alarm because my phone was on silent.
answer.example_zh: 手机设成静音，我没听到闹钟提醒。
answer.usage_note: miss the alarm在此指未听见或未注意到提醒；不表示错过预约。

answer.example_en: I set a backup alarm in case the first one doesn't wake me.
answer.example_zh: 我设了一个备用闹钟，以防第一个闹钟叫不醒我。
answer.usage_note: backup alarm是额外的唤醒提醒。

rows.gloss: 振动；（手机或闹钟）以振动提醒

answer.meaning_zh: 振动；（手机或闹钟）以振动提醒
answer.example_en: My phone vibrates when the alarm goes off.
answer.example_zh: 闹钟响起时，我的手机会振动。
answer.usage_note: vibrate指振动；在设备语境中可以代替铃声提示。

answer.example_en: I changed my ringtone so I could recognize my phone.
answer.example_zh: 我换了手机铃声，好分辨自己的手机。
answer.usage_note: ringtone是来电等提醒的铃声；闹钟声未必称ringtone。

answer.example_en: I requested a wake-up call for six thirty.
answer.example_zh: 我要求酒店在六点半打电话叫醒我。
answer.usage_note: 旅馆语境中wake-up call指叫醒服务电话；也可比喻警醒。

answer.example_en: I like to take a short walk every morning.
answer.example_zh: 我喜欢每天早晨散一小会儿步。
answer.usage_note: morning通常指从清晨到中午前的时段。

answer.example_en: We left home at dawn to avoid the traffic.
answer.example_zh: 我们黎明时出发，避开交通拥堵。
answer.usage_note: dawn是天开始亮的时段，未必已看到太阳升起。

answer.example_en: The birds started singing at daybreak.
answer.example_zh: 天刚亮时，鸟儿就开始唱了。
answer.usage_note: daybreak强调天开始亮，与dawn很接近。

answer.example_en: We watched the sunrise from the balcony.
answer.example_zh: 我们从阳台看日出。
answer.usage_note: sunrise指太阳从地平线上升起的过程或时刻。

answer.example_en: It's still early, so we don't have to leave yet.
answer.example_zh: 时间还早，我们不用现在就走。
answer.usage_note: early强调比通常或预期时间早，不必指凌晨。

answer.example_en: I was late for work because the train was delayed.
answer.example_zh: 火车晚点，导致我上班迟到了。
answer.usage_note: late表示迟于预定时间，与early相反。

answer.example_en: I got to the station on time for the first train.
answer.example_zh: 我准时到达车站，赶上首班车。
answer.usage_note: on time表示按计划时间，区别于in time强调来得及。

answer.example_en: We finished getting ready ahead of schedule.
answer.example_zh: 我们提前完成了出门准备。
answer.usage_note: ahead of schedule指比原计划进度快。

answer.example_en: We're behind schedule, so let's leave right now.
answer.example_zh: 我们进度落后了，现在就出发吧。
answer.usage_note: behind schedule表示落后于原定时间安排。

answer.example_en: I was in a hurry and forgot my keys.
answer.example_zh: 我赶时间，忘了带钥匙。
answer.usage_note: in a hurry指匆忙或急于行动。

answer.example_en: Don't rush; we still have twenty minutes.
answer.example_zh: 别着急，我们还有二十分钟。
answer.usage_note: rush常作动词，表示急匆匆地做事或赶路。

answer.example_en: Hurry up or we'll miss the bus.
answer.example_zh: 快点，不然我们就赶不上公交车了。
answer.usage_note: hurry up常用于催促别人加快动作。

answer.example_en: Take your time getting ready; we're not leaving yet.
answer.example_zh: 慢慢准备，我们还不出发。
answer.usage_note: take your time表示不用着急，不是让人占用别人的时间。

answer.example_en: Making coffee is part of my daily routine.
answer.example_zh: 冲咖啡是我日常习惯的一部分。
answer.usage_note: daily routine指每天反复进行的活动安排。

answer.example_en: I usually wake up at six on weekdays.
answer.example_zh: 工作日我通常六点醒来。
answer.usage_note: weekday通常指周一至周五；并非所有地方都把它等同于实际工作日。

answer.example_en: I don't set an alarm on the weekend.
answer.example_zh: 周末我不设闹钟。
answer.usage_note: weekend一般指周六和周日；一些地区的周末安排可能不同。

answer.example_en: Tomorrow is my day off, so I can sleep in.
answer.example_zh: 明天我休息，可以睡个懒觉。
answer.usage_note: day off指不用上班或上课的休息日。

answer.example_en: We have an early start tomorrow, so let's go to bed.
answer.example_zh: 明天要很早开始一天的活动，我们早点睡吧。
answer.usage_note: early start常指一天或活动较早开始。

answer.example_en: We have time to spare before our appointment.
answer.example_zh: 距预约时间还有一段空余时间。
answer.usage_note: time to spare表示完成必要安排后还有余裕。

answer.example_en: We're running out of time, so we need to leave.
answer.example_zh: 我们快没时间了，得出发了。
answer.usage_note: run out of time表示可用时间即将耗尽。

answer.example_en: I leave the house at seven thirty every morning.
answer.example_zh: 我每天早晨七点半出门。
answer.usage_note: leave the house强调从家里出发，不一定是离开某栋建筑的任何房间。

answer.example_en: Our departure time is six forty-five.
answer.example_zh: 我们的出发时间是六点四十五分。
answer.usage_note: departure time指计划或实际出发的时刻，常用于交通行程。

answer.example_en: We'd better get going if we want to catch the train.
answer.example_zh: 想赶上火车，我们最好动身了。
answer.usage_note: get going常用来表示开始行动或启程。

answer.example_en: I have a doctor's appointment at nine.
answer.example_zh: 我九点有个医生预约。
answer.usage_note: appointment多指约定好时间的会面或服务。

answer.example_en: I checked my schedule before leaving home.
answer.example_zh: 出门前我查看了日程安排。
answer.usage_note: schedule可指时间表或日程安排。

answer.example_en: I put the meeting on my calendar.
answer.example_zh: 我把会议记进了日程表。
answer.usage_note: calendar除日历外，也常指电子日程工具。

answer.example_en: First thing in the morning, I check my messages.
answer.example_zh: 早上一起来，我首先查看消息。
collocations: call first thing in the morning
answer.usage_note: 指早晨很早或首先做某事，不必是字面上的第一件物品。

answer.example_en: I drink a glass of water before breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 我在早餐前喝一杯水。
answer.usage_note: before breakfast表示早餐之前；before后可直接接名词短语。

answer.example_en: I usually brush my teeth after breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 我通常吃完早餐后刷牙。
collocations: go for a walk after breakfast
answer.usage_note: after breakfast表示早餐之后；after后接名词短语。

answer.example_en: I opened my eyes when the alarm rang.
answer.example_zh: 闹钟响起时，我睁开了眼睛。
answer.usage_note: open your eyes是睁开眼睛，通常与睡醒动作相连。

answer.example_en: I rubbed my eyes because I was still sleepy.
answer.example_zh: 我还很困，就揉了揉眼睛。
answer.usage_note: rub your eyes表示用手揉眼睛。

answer.example_en: I blinked a few times as the sunlight came in.
answer.example_zh: 阳光照进来时，我眨了几下眼。
answer.usage_note: blink表示快速闭眼再睁眼。

answer.example_en: I sat up in bed when I heard the alarm.
answer.example_zh: 听到闹钟响，我从床上坐了起来。
answer.usage_note: sit up指从躺姿坐起来，或坐直身子。

rows.expression: sit on the edge of the bed

answer.example_en: She sat on the edge of the bed to put on her slippers.
answer.example_zh: 她坐在床边穿拖鞋。
collocations: sit on the edge of the bed
answer.usage_note: edge of the bed指床沿。

answer.example_en: I stood up and walked to the bathroom.
answer.example_zh: 我站起身，走向浴室。
answer.usage_note: stand up表示从坐姿等姿势站起。

answer.example_en: I rolled over and checked the time on my phone.
answer.example_zh: 我翻了个身，看了看手机上的时间。
answer.usage_note: roll over表示身体翻到另一侧；也可有其他领域义项。

answer.example_en: He turned over in bed and went back to sleep.
answer.example_zh: 他在床上翻了个身，又睡着了。
answer.usage_note: turn over在此指翻身，其他语境可指翻转物体。

answer.example_en: I pulled back the covers and got out of bed.
answer.example_zh: 我掀开被子，下了床。
answer.usage_note: covers在床铺语境中指被褥等覆盖物。

answer.example_en: I threw off the covers as soon as the alarm rang.
answer.example_zh: 闹钟一响，我就一下子掀开了被子。
answer.usage_note: throw off带有迅速掀开的动作感。

answer.example_en: It was chilly, so I pulled up the covers.
answer.example_zh: 天有点冷，我就把被子往上拉了拉。
answer.usage_note: 这里pull up指将被子往身体上方拉，不是起床。

answer.example_en: I got back into bed for another ten minutes.
answer.example_zh: 我又回到床上躺了十分钟。
collocations: get back into bed after breakfast
answer.usage_note: get back into bed表示再次上床，区别于get out of bed。

answer.example_en: I straightened the sheets before making the bed.
answer.example_zh: 铺床之前，我先把床单铺平了。
answer.usage_note: straighten在这里是整理平整，不是洗床单。

answer.example_en: She fluffed the pillow before lying down.
answer.example_zh: 她躺下前拍松了枕头。
answer.usage_note: fluff指拍打、抖松填充物使其蓬松。

answer.example_en: Please fold the blanket and put it on the chair.
answer.example_zh: 请把毯子叠好放在椅子上。
answer.usage_note: fold强调折叠，和put away（收纳）不同。

answer.example_en: I put away the blanket after folding it.
answer.example_zh: 我把毯子叠好后收了起来。
answer.usage_note: put away强调收回指定位置，不必然包含折叠动作。

answer.example_en: I sat on the edge of the bed to put on my socks.
answer.example_zh: 我坐在床沿穿袜子。
answer.usage_note: bed是可数名词；go to bed通常不加冠词，指去睡觉。

answer.example_en: This mattress is too soft for my back.
answer.example_zh: 这张床垫对我的背来说太软了。
answer.usage_note: mattress指床垫，不是整张床。

answer.example_en: I turned my pillow over to the cool side.
answer.example_zh: 我把枕头翻了个面，换到凉快的那一侧。
collocations: rest your head on a pillow
answer.usage_note: pillow是枕头；cushion通常指沙发等处的靠垫。

answer.example_en: I changed the pillowcase this morning.
answer.example_zh: 我今天早上换了枕套。
answer.usage_note: pillowcase是套在枕头外面的布套。

answer.example_en: I pulled the bedsheet tight over the mattress.
answer.example_zh: 我把床单拉平，紧紧铺在床垫上。
answer.usage_note: bedsheet也常说sheet；fitted sheet指四角有松紧带的床笠式床单。

answer.example_en: I keep an extra blanket at the foot of the bed.
answer.example_zh: 我在床尾放了一条备用毯子。
answer.usage_note: blanket通常指毯子，不必等同于有填充物的厚被。

answer.example_en: I shook out the duvet before making the bed.
answer.example_zh: 铺床前，我把羽绒被抖了抖。
answer.usage_note: duvet通常指有填充物的被子，duvet cover是被套；地区用法可能不同。

rows.gloss: 厚被子；美式英语中常指填充被

answer.meaning_zh: 厚被子；美式英语中常指填充被
answer.example_en: The comforter was warm enough that I didn't need another blanket.
answer.example_zh: 这床厚被子够暖和了，我不需要再加毯子。
answer.usage_note: comforter在美式英语里常指有填充物的厚被子。

answer.example_en: I stayed under the covers for a few more minutes.
answer.example_zh: 我又在被窝里待了几分钟。
answer.usage_note: covers在床上语境常泛指被子、床单等盖在身上的寝具。

answer.example_en: I left my glasses on the bedside table.
answer.example_zh: 我把眼镜放在床头柜上了。
answer.usage_note: bedside table是床旁小桌或柜，美式也常说nightstand。

answer.example_en: My phone was charging on the nightstand.
answer.example_zh: 我的手机放在床头柜上充电。
answer.usage_note: nightstand尤其常见于美式英语，与bedside table意思接近。

answer.example_en: I slipped on my slippers before going to the kitchen.
answer.example_zh: 我去厨房之前趿上了拖鞋。
answer.usage_note: slippers常用复数，表示室内拖鞋；slip on是迅速穿上。

answer.example_en: I put on my bathrobe after getting out of the shower.
answer.example_zh: 洗完澡出来后，我穿上了浴袍。
answer.usage_note: bathrobe用于洗澡后或居家穿着，robe在上下文中也可这样指称。

answer.example_en: I opened the curtains to let in the morning sun.
answer.example_zh: 我拉开窗帘，让早晨的阳光照进来。
answer.usage_note: draw the curtains可能表示拉上或拉开，须结合上下文；open更明确。

answer.example_en: The blinds were still closed when I woke up.
answer.example_zh: 我醒来时百叶帘还关着。
answer.usage_note: blinds通常为复数；raise/lower表示升降窗帘。

answer.example_en: I opened the curtains as soon as I got up.
answer.example_zh: 我一起床就拉开了窗帘。
answer.usage_note: 强调打开窗帘；关窗帘通常说close the curtains。

answer.example_en: I closed the blinds to block the bright sunlight.
answer.example_zh: 阳光太刺眼，我把百叶帘合上了。
answer.usage_note: close the blinds可以指合上叶片或拉下遮挡，视窗帘类型而定。

answer.example_en: I pulled back the curtains to let in some light.
answer.example_zh: 我拉开窗帘，让一些光照进屋里。
answer.usage_note: let in是让光、空气等进入，宾语可以放在中间：let some light in。

answer.example_en: I opened the window to cool down the room.
answer.example_zh: 我打开窗户，让房间凉快一点。
answer.usage_note: open a window a crack表示把窗户开一条小缝。

answer.example_en: I stepped onto the balcony to get some fresh air.
answer.example_zh: 我走到阳台上透透气。
collocations: go out for some fresh air
answer.usage_note: 通常表示到户外或通风处呼吸新鲜空气。

answer.example_en: I turned on the light because it was still dark.
answer.example_zh: 天还黑着，我就开了灯。
answer.usage_note: turn on用于开启电灯等设备，反义为turn off。

answer.example_en: Please turn off the light before you leave.
answer.example_zh: 离开前请关灯。
answer.usage_note: 代词宾语须放在中间，如turn it off，而非turn off it。

answer.example_en: I checked the time and realized I was running late.
answer.example_zh: 我看了眼时间，发现自己快迟到了。
collocations: check the time on your phone
answer.usage_note: check the time指查看几点，不等于set the time（校准时间）。

answer.example_en: I reached for my phone before I was fully awake.
answer.example_zh: 我还没完全清醒就伸手去拿手机了。
answer.usage_note: reach for强调伸手去够，未必已经拿到。

answer.example_en: I sat still for a minute before standing up.
answer.example_zh: 站起来之前，我静静坐了一会儿。
answer.usage_note: still在这里表示不动，而非“仍然”。

answer.example_en: I felt groggy when the alarm went off.
answer.example_zh: 闹钟响时，我还昏昏沉沉的。
answer.usage_note: groggy尤其强调刚睡醒时头脑不清醒，也可用于病后或用药后。

answer.example_en: I was still drowsy after my morning shower.
answer.example_zh: 早上洗完澡后，我还是昏昏欲睡。
answer.usage_note: drowsy强调困倦想睡；groggy更强调脑子不清醒。

answer.example_en: I'm tired because I stayed up too late last night.
answer.example_zh: 我累了，因为昨晚睡得太晚。
answer.usage_note: tired表示疲倦，程度一般低于exhausted。

answer.example_en: I was exhausted after a night of broken sleep.
answer.example_zh: 昨晚断断续续没睡好，早上我筋疲力尽。
answer.usage_note: exhausted比tired程度强，常指非常疲惫。

answer.example_en: A short walk helps me feel more alert in the morning.
answer.example_zh: 早晨散一小会儿步能让我更清醒。
answer.usage_note: alert指注意力集中、反应敏捷，不只是醒着。

answer.example_en: I usually feel energetic after a good night's sleep.
answer.example_zh: 睡了个好觉后，我通常精力充沛。
answer.usage_note: energetic表示有活力，可以形容人或行为。

answer.example_en: I feel sluggish until I've had breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 早餐前我总觉得没精神、动作慢吞吞的。
answer.usage_note: sluggish强调反应或行动迟缓，不单是困。

answer.example_en: I felt completely drained after working late.
answer.example_zh: 昨晚加班到很晚，早上我感觉精力被掏空了。
answer.usage_note: drained常指体力或精神被耗尽；exhausted侧重极度疲劳。

answer.example_en: I felt refreshed after washing my face.
answer.example_zh: 洗过脸后，我感觉精神了一些。
answer.usage_note: refreshed表示休息或清洁后恢复清爽和精力。

answer.example_en: My shoulders feel stiff when I first get up.
answer.example_zh: 我刚起床时肩膀有些僵硬。
answer.usage_note: stiff强调关节或肌肉不灵活，不一定伴随明显疼痛。

answer.example_en: My legs were sore after yesterday's workout.
answer.example_zh: 昨天锻炼后，我今天腿有些酸痛。
answer.usage_note: sore常用于肌肉酸痛或触碰时疼痛。

answer.example_en: I woke up feeling achy all over.
answer.example_zh: 我早上醒来觉得浑身隐隐作痛。
answer.usage_note: achy表示持续的钝痛、隐痛，口语中常见。

answer.example_en: I felt dizzy when I got out of bed too quickly.
answer.example_zh: 我起床太快，站起来时觉得头晕。
answer.usage_note: dizzy可指眩晕或头晕；若特别强调快要晕厥，可用lightheaded。

answer.example_en: I felt lightheaded after standing up suddenly.
answer.example_zh: 我猛地站起来后感到一阵头昏。
answer.usage_note: lightheaded更偏向发飘、快晕倒的感觉，不一定是天旋地转。

answer.example_en: I woke up with a headache this morning.
answer.example_zh: 今天早上醒来时我就头痛。
answer.usage_note: headache是可数名词，通常说have a headache。

answer.example_en: I'm thirsty, so I'll have some water first.
answer.example_zh: 我口渴了，先喝点水。
answer.usage_note: thirsty表示口渴，常用be/get thirsty。

answer.example_en: I'm hungry already, even though it's only seven.
answer.example_zh: 才七点我就已经饿了。
answer.usage_note: hungry强调饥饿，常说I'm hungry而非I have hungry。

answer.example_en: I'm cold; could you close the window?
answer.example_zh: 我有点冷，你能把窗户关上吗？
answer.usage_note: I'm cold指自己觉得冷；It's cold指环境冷。

answer.example_en: I feel warm now that the heater is on.
answer.example_zh: 暖气开了，我现在觉得暖和了。
answer.usage_note: warm形容舒适的暖意，hot则通常是更高的温度。

answer.example_en: I'm always a little grumpy before breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 早饭前我总有点起床气。
answer.usage_note: grumpy是脾气不佳、容易抱怨，不专指起床气。

answer.example_en: The kids get cranky when they haven't slept enough.
answer.example_zh: 孩子们睡不够就容易烦躁。
answer.usage_note: cranky常指因疲劳或不适而烦躁易怒，口语常用。

answer.example_en: She sounded cheerful when she called me this morning.
answer.example_zh: 她今天早上给我打电话时听起来心情很好。
answer.usage_note: cheerful强调愉快、积极的情绪，也可形容声音或气氛。

answer.example_en: I stayed calm even though I was running late.
answer.example_zh: 虽然快迟到了，我还是保持冷静。
answer.usage_note: calm强调平静、镇定；不一定表示高兴。

answer.example_en: I feel stressed when I check work emails first thing.
answer.example_zh: 我一早就看工作邮件时会感到压力很大。
answer.usage_note: stressed表示感到压力，常与about连用。

answer.example_en: I felt anxious about the meeting as soon as I woke up.
answer.example_zh: 我一醒来就为那场会议感到焦虑。
answer.usage_note: anxious about常表示忧虑，anxious to do有时表示急切想做。

answer.example_en: I felt relaxed after a quiet breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 安安静静吃完早饭后，我感到很放松。
answer.usage_note: relaxed形容人的放松状态；relaxing形容让人放松的事物。

answer.example_en: I woke up motivated to finish my project.
answer.example_zh: 我醒来时干劲十足，想把项目完成。
answer.usage_note: motivated常与to do搭配，表示有动力做某事。

answer.example_en: I feel better after drinking some water.
answer.example_zh: 喝了点水后，我感觉好多了。
answer.usage_note: feel better可指身体好些，也可指心情好些，需看语境。

rows.expression: feel like going back to bed

answer.example_en: It's so cold that I feel like going back to bed.
answer.example_zh: 天太冷了，我想回床上再躺会儿。
collocations: feel like going back to bed
answer.usage_note: feel like后接名词或动名词，不接动词原形。

answer.example_en: I need a minute before I can talk to anyone.
answer.example_zh: 我得缓一会儿才能跟人说话。
answer.usage_note: need a minute是自然口语，常表示需要一点时间调整状态。

answer.example_en: I went outside for five minutes to clear my head.
answer.example_zh: 我出去待了五分钟，让脑子清醒一下。
collocations: go for a walk to clear your head
answer.usage_note: clear your head指排除杂念、理清思路，不是字面清洗头部。

answer.example_en: A splash of cold water helps wake me up.
answer.example_zh: 用冷水扑一下脸能让我清醒些。
collocations: do something to wake yourself up
answer.usage_note: wake yourself up强调采取动作让自己清醒；wake up也可直接表示醒来。

answer.example_en: I usually perk up after a cup of tea.
answer.example_zh: 我喝完一杯茶通常就精神起来了。
answer.usage_note: perk up表示重新活跃或精神振作，既可不及物也可带宾语。

answer.example_en: I brush my teeth as soon as I wake up because of morning breath.
answer.example_zh: 我一醒来就刷牙，因为早晨口气不太好。
answer.usage_note: morning breath是口语中指睡醒后口气不清新的固定表达。

answer.example_en: My eyes look puffy when I don't get enough sleep.
answer.example_zh: 睡眠不足时，我的眼睛看起来浮肿。
answer.usage_note: puffy表示浮肿、肿胀；不是说眼睛本身很大。

answer.example_en: I woke up with a stuffy nose and had trouble breathing through it.
answer.example_zh: 我醒来时鼻子堵着，用鼻子呼吸不太顺畅。
collocations: wake up with a stuffy nose
answer.usage_note: stuffy nose是日常说法；blocked nose在英式英语也常用。

answer.example_en: I often wake up with a dry mouth if I sleep with my mouth open.
answer.example_zh: 如果张嘴睡觉，我早上常会口干。
collocations: wake up with a dry mouth
answer.usage_note: dry mouth指口腔干燥，不同于dry lips（嘴唇干）。

answer.example_en: It takes me a while to shake off sleep inertia in the morning.
answer.example_zh: 早上我需要过一阵子才能摆脱刚醒来的迟钝感。
answer.usage_note: sleep inertia是偏专业术语，指醒后短暂的困倦及认知反应下降。

answer.example_en: I woke up with a stiff neck after sleeping awkwardly.
answer.example_zh: 睡姿别扭，醒来时我脖子僵硬。
collocations: wake up with a stiff neck
answer.usage_note: stiff neck指脖子僵硬，也可能伴随疼痛；不必然意味着医学诊断。

answer.example_en: I've had low energy all morning because I barely slept.
answer.example_zh: 昨晚几乎没睡，整个上午我都没精神。
answer.usage_note: low energy在口语中表示精力不足；也可用feel drained。

answer.example_en: I feel rested after eight hours of sleep.
answer.example_zh: 睡了八小时后，我觉得休息够了。
answer.usage_note: rested表示休息充分，well-rested可作复合形容词。

answer.example_en: I need to freshen up before we leave.
answer.example_zh: 出门前我得简单洗漱整理一下。
answer.usage_note: freshen up可指洗脸、梳头、整理仪容，不必是完整洗澡。

answer.example_en: I rinsed my mouth with water after brushing my teeth.
answer.example_zh: 刷完牙后，我用水漱了口。
answer.usage_note: rinse强调用水冲洗；漱口水常说mouthwash。

answer.example_en: I take a shower every morning before breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 我每天早饭前洗淋浴。
answer.usage_note: 美式常说take a shower，英式也常说have a shower。

answer.example_en: I like to take a warm bath on weekends.
answer.example_zh: 周末我喜欢泡个热水澡。
answer.usage_note: take a bath通常指在浴缸里泡澡，不等同于快速淋浴。

answer.example_en: I dried off with a towel after my shower.
answer.example_zh: 淋浴后我用毛巾擦干了身体。
answer.usage_note: dry off指把身上的水擦干；dry off也可用于物体。

answer.example_en: I comb my hair carefully when it's tangled.
answer.example_zh: 头发打结时，我会仔细用梳子梳。
answer.usage_note: comb通常暗示用梳子整理；brush常暗示用发刷。

answer.example_en: I brush my hair before leaving the house.
answer.example_zh: 出门前我会梳一梳头发。
answer.usage_note: brush your hair指用发刷梳头；不宜与brush your teeth混淆。

answer.example_en: I got dressed quickly because I was running late.
answer.example_zh: 我快迟到了，就赶紧穿好衣服。
answer.usage_note: get dressed强调整个穿衣过程；put on a shirt指穿上一件具体衣物。

answer.example_en: Put on some warm clothes before you go outside.
answer.example_zh: 出门前穿些暖和的衣服。
answer.usage_note: put on强调穿上的动作，wear强调已经穿着的状态。

answer.example_en: I took off my pajamas and got into my work clothes.
answer.example_zh: 我脱下睡衣，换上了上班穿的衣服。
answer.usage_note: pajamas常作复数，take off与put on相对。

answer.example_en: I need to change clothes before breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 我得在早饭前换身衣服。
answer.usage_note: change into表示换上某类衣服，change out of表示脱下原来穿的衣服。

answer.example_en: I picked out an outfit for the interview last night.
answer.example_zh: 我昨晚挑好了面试要穿的一套衣服。
answer.usage_note: outfit通常指搭配好的一套衣服，不仅是一件衣物。

answer.example_en: I laid out my clothes the night before to save time.
answer.example_zh: 为了省时间，我前一晚就把要穿的衣服摆好了。
answer.usage_note: lay out是把物品摊开、摆好；这里暗示提前准备，过去式laid out。

answer.example_en: Give me ten minutes to get myself ready.
answer.example_zh: 给我十分钟把自己收拾好。
answer.usage_note: get yourself ready可包含穿衣、洗漱等准备；不等于只化妆。

answer.example_en: I get the kids ready for school while my partner makes breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 伴侣做早饭时，我帮孩子们做好上学准备。
collocations: get the kids ready for school
answer.usage_note: get someone ready表示帮助别人准备好，不能说get the kids prepare。

answer.example_en: I tidied up the bedroom before leaving.
answer.example_zh: 出门前我简单收拾了一下卧室。
answer.usage_note: tidy up重在收拾整齐，未必是彻底清洁。

answer.example_en: Please put your things away before breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 早餐前请把你的东西收好。
answer.usage_note: put away表示收回适当位置，代词应置中：put them away。

answer.example_en: I drink a glass of water as soon as I wake up.
answer.example_zh: 我一醒来就喝一杯水。
answer.usage_note: glass of water是一个量词结构；口语中have a glass of water也自然。

answer.example_en: I'll make coffee while you get dressed.
answer.example_zh: 你穿衣服的时候我来冲咖啡。
answer.usage_note: make coffee是日常广义表达，不限定使用哪种冲煮方法。

answer.example_en: I brew coffee with freshly ground beans every morning.
answer.example_zh: 我每天早晨用现磨咖啡豆冲泡咖啡。
answer.usage_note: brew强调冲煮或萃取过程，不一定是在锅里煮沸。

answer.example_en: Could you make some tea while I pack my bag?
answer.example_zh: 我收拾包的时候，你能泡点茶吗？
answer.usage_note: make tea可泛指泡茶，具体操作常用brew或steep描述。

answer.example_en: I'll put the kettle on before I take a shower.
answer.example_zh: 我洗澡前先把水壶烧上。
collocations: put the kettle on for tea
answer.usage_note: 英式口语常用，意为把水壶放上去烧水或启动电水壶。

answer.example_en: I grabbed breakfast at the station on my way to work.
answer.example_zh: 我上班路上在车站匆匆吃了点早饭。
answer.usage_note: grab a meal强调快捷、顺便吃，不表示用手抓食物。

answer.example_en: I skipped breakfast because I had an early meeting.
answer.example_zh: 因为一早有会，我没吃早饭。
answer.usage_note: skip在这里是省略或不吃，不是跳跃。

answer.example_en: I usually make breakfast for the family on Sundays.
answer.example_zh: 周日通常由我给家人做早餐。
answer.usage_note: make someone breakfast表示给某人做早餐，常见双宾语结构。

answer.example_en: I had toast with butter and jam for breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 我早饭吃了抹黄油和果酱的烤面包片。
answer.usage_note: toast作早餐食物通常为不可数名词；a slice of toast指一片。

answer.example_en: I poured some cereal into a bowl and added milk.
answer.example_zh: 我往碗里倒了些早餐谷物片，又加了牛奶。
answer.usage_note: cereal在这里指即食早餐谷物，也可在其他语境泛指谷类作物。

answer.example_en: I made oatmeal with milk and sliced bananas.
answer.example_zh: 我用牛奶和香蕉片煮了燕麦粥。
answer.usage_note: oatmeal在美式语境常指煮好的燕麦粥，英式常说porridge。

answer.example_en: I packed lunch for tomorrow before going to bed.
answer.example_zh: 睡前我把明天带的午饭打包好了。
answer.usage_note: pack lunch强调准备便当携带，不是去餐馆点外卖。

answer.example_en: I packed my bag with my laptop and notebook.
answer.example_zh: 我把笔记本电脑和记事本装进了包里。
answer.usage_note: pack强调把所需物品装进包中；也可说pack for a trip。

answer.example_en: Don't forget to grab your keys on the way out.
answer.example_zh: 出门时别忘了拿上钥匙。
answer.usage_note: grab在口语中常表示顺手拿上，不一定是猛抓。

answer.example_en: I grabbed my phone from the nightstand.
answer.example_zh: 我从床头柜上顺手拿起手机。
answer.usage_note: grab比pick up更口语、更有迅速拿起的意味。

answer.example_en: I try not to check my phone as soon as I wake up.
answer.example_zh: 我尽量不在刚醒来时就看手机。
answer.usage_note: check your phone多指查看消息、时间或通知，而非检查设备是否损坏。

answer.example_en: I checked my messages before leaving the house.
answer.example_zh: 出门前我查看了消息。
answer.usage_note: messages可包括短信或聊天应用消息，依上下文而定。

answer.example_en: I check the weather before deciding what to wear.
answer.example_zh: 我会先看天气，再决定穿什么。
answer.usage_note: check the weather可指查看当前天气或预报，不限定数据来源。

answer.example_en: I checked my schedule to see when the meeting starts.
answer.example_zh: 我查看了日程，确认会议几点开始。
answer.usage_note: schedule表示日程安排，既可以指工作日程，也可指课程表等。

answer.example_en: I forgot to charge my phone overnight.
answer.example_zh: 我忘了晚上给手机充电。
answer.usage_note: charge表示给设备充电；charge someone money则是收费的不同义项。

answer.example_en: I unplugged my phone before heading out.
answer.example_zh: 出门前我把手机的充电线拔掉了。
answer.usage_note: unplug在这里是拔除电源连接，不代表把手机关机。

answer.example_en: I put on my shoes by the front door.
answer.example_zh: 我在大门旁穿上了鞋。
answer.usage_note: put on强调穿鞋动作，通常shoes用复数。

answer.example_en: Put on a coat; it's freezing outside.
answer.example_zh: 穿上外套吧，外面冷得很。
answer.usage_note: coat通常是较厚的外套，jacket一般较短或较轻便。

answer.example_en: We need to head out by eight to catch the train.
answer.example_zh: 我们得八点前出门才能赶上火车。
answer.usage_note: head out是口语中的出发、离开，常带有目的地。

answer.example_en: I head to work around eight every weekday.
answer.example_zh: 每个工作日我大约八点去上班。
answer.usage_note: head to表示朝目的地去；work在此不加冠词。

answer.example_en: The children head to school together every morning.
answer.example_zh: 孩子们每天早晨一起去上学。
answer.usage_note: school作为上学目的地通常不加冠词。

answer.example_en: She brushed her hair back and tied it up.
answer.example_zh: 她把头发往后梳，然后扎了起来。
collocations: brush your hair away from your face
answer.usage_note: brush back强调梳向后方，不一定意味着固定发型。

answer.example_en: Remember to wash your hands before breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 记得早餐前洗手。
answer.usage_note: wash your hands是洗手；rinse your hands更强调只用水冲。

answer.example_en: I apply moisturizer after washing my face.
answer.example_zh: 我洗完脸后会擦保湿霜。
answer.usage_note: apply是稍正式且常见的护肤说法；口语也会说put on moisturizer。

answer.example_en: I put on sunscreen even when it's cloudy.
answer.example_zh: 即使阴天我也会涂防晒霜。
answer.usage_note: sunscreen通常作不可数名词，常说put on some sunscreen。

answer.example_en: I take my medication at the same time each morning.
answer.example_zh: 我每天早上都在同一时间服用药物。
answer.usage_note: take medication是服药的自然说法；这里不涉及剂量建议。

answer.example_en: I take my vitamins with breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 我吃早饭时服用维生素补充剂。
answer.usage_note: take vitamins指服用维生素补充剂，不等于从食物中摄取维生素。

answer.example_en: I fill my water bottle before leaving for work.
answer.example_zh: 上班出门前我会把水瓶装满。
answer.usage_note: fill A with B是用B装满A；fill up也很常用。

answer.example_en: I check my commute before leaving in case there's heavy traffic.
answer.example_zh: 出门前我会查查通勤路况，以防堵车。
collocations: check the traffic for your commute
answer.usage_note: check your commute常是查看通勤路线、拥堵或延误状况。

answer.example_en: I feed the cat before I make breakfast.
answer.example_zh: 我做早饭前先喂猫。
collocations: feed the cat twice a day
answer.usage_note: feed someone/something表示给其提供食物。

answer.example_en: I walk the dog every morning before work.
answer.example_zh: 我每天上班前都遛狗。
collocations: take the dog for a walk
answer.usage_note: walk the dog是固定常用表达，不是和狗一起散步的直译结构。

answer.example_en: I pack the kids' lunches while they're getting dressed.
answer.example_zh: 孩子们穿衣服时，我准备他们带去学校的午饭。
answer.usage_note: kids'是复数所有格；lunches指给多个孩子分别准备的午餐。

rows.expression: make sure the door is locked

answer.example_en: I always make sure the door is locked before leaving.
answer.example_zh: 每次出门前我都会确认门锁好了。
collocations: make sure the door is locked
check that the door is locked
answer.usage_note: make sure后接完整从句，表示确保或确认。

answer.example_en: Please turn off the lights when you leave the room.
answer.example_zh: 离开房间时请把灯关掉。
answer.usage_note: lights为复数，指房间里一盏或多盏灯时常用。

answer.example_en: It looks like rain, so grab an umbrella.
answer.example_zh: 看起来要下雨了，带把伞吧。
answer.usage_note: grab在这里指顺手拿上，语气比take更随意。

answer.example_en: I hit the snooze button twice before getting up.
answer.example_zh: 起床前我按了两次贪睡按钮。
answer.usage_note: hit在这里是按下，不是用力击打；该功能让闹钟稍后再响。

answer.example_en: A short walk helps me shake off my morning grogginess.
answer.example_zh: 走一小会儿路能让我摆脱早晨刚醒时的昏沉感。
answer.usage_note: grogginess指昏沉、反应慢，尤其见于睡醒后。

answer.example_en: It takes us twenty minutes to get out the door with two kids.
answer.example_zh: 带着两个孩子，我们得花二十分钟才能真正出门。
answer.usage_note: get out the door偏口语，强调完成准备并终于离家；不等同于get out of the door的逐字结构。

answer.example_en: I turned on the alarm for six thirty tomorrow morning.
answer.example_zh: 我打开了明早六点半的闹钟。
answer.usage_note: turn on the alarm在手机场景中可指启用已有闹钟；设定新时间更常说set an alarm。
